name: smwmusic-castlevania-ii-simon-s-quest-castle-of-distortion-dwelling-of-doom-remix
title: Castlevania II: Simon's Quest - Castle of Distortion ~ Dwelling of Doom (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Dwelling of Doom. Was in the mood for some Castlevania II music again and decided to do this 'cuz it slaps, despite it being used in some of the most frustrating stages in all of Castlevania.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Custom Pitch)
